references.text: Moses encourages Joshua not to fear, the same encouragement the Lord gives Joshua here.
God's promise to deliver the enemies into Israel's hand repeats as a recurring theme.
Moses exhorts Joshua with the words 'Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed,' the same wording the Lord uses here.
The Lord's original command to Joshua not to fear when he took over leadership.
The Lord gives Jericho into Joshua's hand in a similar way as He promises here to give Ai.
The first defeat at Ai, which is now to be restored with this new command from the Lord.
The Lord repeats the same encouragement to Joshua: 'Do not be afraid of them, for I have given them into your hand.'
Again the Lord assures Joshua of victory with the words 'Do not be afraid of them.'
God's word 'Do not be afraid' as a recurring assurance to His people.
